A '''grav-bike''' was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] of [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] design, used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. A group of Alliance [[operative]]s used the grav-bikes during a mission to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial asteroid base|base]] on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].<ref name="ASG" />
